tagline: Relentless Advocacy. Uncompromising Legal Ethics. Proven Courtroom Results.
bio: Advocate Noor Alam Khatri is a distinguished High Court legal practitioner with over 18 years of courtroom experience. Specializing in Constitutional Writs, Complex Civil Litigation, High-Stakes Commercial Disputes, and Criminal Appeals, Advocate Khatri has built a stellar reputation for meticulous legal analysis, persuasive oral advocacy, and landmark precedent victories.
